note: Alberta Parks campground in the Elbow River valley, 13 km W of Bragg Creek on Hwy 66 (Kananaskis), with well-treed sites on five loops; the agency says several back onto the Elbow River. Interpretive trails from the campground; hiking, riding and biking trails nearby. Bring drinking water (the hand pump is not potable); firewood sold at the manager's site, the firewood truck and McLean Creek's store. --Claude

flags: WATERFRONT (stored riverfront, checked hard): RECOMMEND riverview (not waterfront is defensible). Page: 'Several of the sites back on to the Elbow River.' The Aug 2025 tear sheet (50 m scale bar) puts the nearest sites (Loop A 10-11, Loop C 38-40, Loop E 94-97) roughly 90-120 m from the river, with the interpretive trail between them and the bank. Esri imagery is winter/snow-covered: the loops are in dense spruce on a terrace, and below it a gravel floodplain 60-100 m wide separates the forest edge from the active channel. No site is within ~50 m of the water on open ground. Any river view would be from the east edges of loops A and C through trees.
